threats.title: CISA Emergency Directive: In-The-Wild Exploitation of Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software
threats.entities: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software Enterprise Deployments
threats.incident: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.
threats.rootCause: Adversaries actively weaponizing remote unauthenticated exploitation against internet-facing perimeters.
threats.consequence: Required federal mitigation: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines. Due date: 2026-11-01.

threats.title: CISA Emergency Directive: In-The-Wild Exploitation of GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition
threats.entities: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Enterprise Deployments
threats.incident: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.
threats.rootCause: Adversaries actively weaponizing remote unauthenticated exploitation against internet-facing perimeters.
threats.consequence: Required federal mitigation: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines. Due date: 2026-11-01.

threats.title: UCO Bank ₹820 Cr IMPS Erroneous Credit Glitch: CBI Files Chargesheet Against 46 People Across 8 States
threats.sourceName: CBI Official Press Release & Court Filings
threats.entities: UCO Bank, 41,000 Retail Account Holders, IMPS Switch Rails
threats.incident: Over Diwali weekend, a core banking glitch erroneously credited ₹820 Crores into 41,000 UCO Bank accounts across India without debits from sending banks, sparking nationwide ATM and UPI cashouts.
threats.rootCause: Reverse-proxy timeout handling mismatch between the IMPS switch gateway and the Finacle core banking system (CBS), causing failed transactions to register as successful credits.
threats.consequence: CBI conducted raids across 67 locations, freezing accounts and recovering ₹649 Cr; RBI issued urgent supervisory audit mandates across all scheduled commercial banks.

threats.title: RBI Penalizes Kotak Mahindra Bank: Halts Digital Onboarding & Credit Cards Over Severe Core Banking IT Deficiencies
threats.ref: RBI Enforcement Order Sec 35A BR Act
threats.entities: Kotak Mahindra Bank Digital Channels & Credit Card Operations
threats.incident: The Reserve Bank of India invoked Section 35A of the Banking Regulation Act to bar Kotak Mahindra Bank from onboarding new customers online and issuing fresh credit cards due to continuous digital outages.
threats.rootCause: Chronic deficiencies in IT inventory management, vendor risk governance, disaster recovery failover readiness, and data security controls across core digital channels.
threats.consequence: Bank mandated to hire an independent auditor approved by RBI to execute a comprehensive IT overhaul before regulatory restrictions are reconsidered.

threats.title: Indian Digital Lending NBFCs Probed Over 1.2M Unencrypted KYC & Credit Appraisal Records Leaked on Dark Web
threats.ref: CERT-In Case IN-2026-8812 / DPDP Act Sec 33
threats.entities: Digital Lending NBFCs, Instant Micro-Loan Apps, KYC Aggregators
threats.incident: Unprotected cloud infrastructure allowed threat actors to dump 1.2 million customer dossiers containing Aadhaar copies, PAN cards, credit scores, and bank statement PDFs onto hacker forums.
threats.rootCause: Misconfigured cloud storage bucket left publicly readable without IAM policy enforcement, combined with hardcoded bucket access credentials inside a third-party micro-lending mobile SDK.
threats.consequence: CERT-In and the Data Protection Board initiated compliance inquiries under India's DPDP Act 2023 with potential financial penalties; affected lenders forced to rotate all cloud API credentials.

threats.title: Cosmos Bank Cyber Heist Case Study: Recovery & Global Interpol Red Notices for ATM Switch Malware Attackers
threats.sourceName: CERT-In Special Forensic Bulletin & Pune Cyber Cell
threats.ref: Interpol Cybercrime Directorate Alert / ₹94 Cr SWIFT Drain
threats.entities: Cosmos Cooperative Bank, ATM Switch Infrastructure, SWIFT Settlement
threats.incident: Hackers compromised Cosmos Bank's internal payment switch, sending thousands of rogue ATM authorization responses across 28 countries within 2 hours, draining ₹94 Crores.
threats.rootCause: Spear-phishing email installed malware on an internal virtual server, establishing a rogue switch that bypassed the Core Banking System (CBS) to auto-approve ATM debit requests.
threats.consequence: Bank implemented air-gapped SWIFT corridors and continuous behavioral anomaly detection; Indian cyber cell and Interpol secured multiple international asset freezes.

threats.title: RBI Halts Bank of Baroda 'BoB World' Mobile App Onboarding After Systematic Mobile Number Linking Breach
threats.sourceName: Reserve Bank of India Enforcement Disclosures
threats.ref: RBI Supervision Press Release / Banking Regulation Act
threats.entities: Bank of Baroda 'BoB World' Mobile App & Branch Staff Network
threats.incident: An investigative probe revealed branch personnel systematically linked unauthorized third-party mobile numbers to dormant savings accounts to artificially inflate active mobile app user metrics.
threats.rootCause: Absence of multi-factor out-of-band verification on core customer mobile update workflows, combined with branch manager supervisor override privileges being abused.
threats.consequence: RBI banned new user onboarding on the BoB World app for months until forensic audit validated the unlinking of 300,000+ unauthorized numbers and dismissed rogue internal operators.

threats.title: CERT-In Emergency Warning: Adversaries Exploiting Edge VPNs & Payment API Gateways Across Indian Financial Corridors
threats.entities: Indian Banking Corridors, Payment Gateways & FinTech Core Switches
threats.incident: Threat actors actively targeted perimeter network hardware in Indian fintechs and clearing hubs to establish persistent backdoors into internal payment settlement networks.
threats.rootCause: Unauthenticated session hijacking and path traversal vulnerabilities in enterprise edge gateways lacking network micro-segmentation.
threats.consequence: CERT-In mandated emergency perimeter patching and zero-trust isolated network segments within 24 hours under statutory penalty guidelines.

threats.title: WazirX $234M Multisig Breach: Lazarus Group Drains 45% of Reserves via Liminal Custody Interface
threats.sourceName: Chainalysis Forensics & Singapore High Court Filings
threats.entities: WazirX Exchange, Liminal Custody Infrastructure, 4.3M User Balances
threats.incident: North Korean Lazarus hackers compromised a 5-of-6 multi-signature wallet, draining over $234 Million in user assets (including 5.4 trillion SHIB, 15,200 ETH, and $11M in MATIC).
threats.rootCause: Blind-signing transaction payload spoofing. While hardware signers verified benign token transactions on their screens, a malicious payload was injected via compromised internal custody infrastructure (Liminal).
threats.consequence: Stolen ETH systematically laundered via Tornado Cash; WazirX filed for a moratorium in Singapore High Court while restructuring balance sheets to absorb user losses.

threats.title: Binance Intelligence & Law Enforcement Task Force Freezes $3.2B in Illicit Crypto; Independent Monitors Installed
threats.sourceName: Bloomberg & U.S. Department of Justice Disclosures
threats.ref: US DOJ Monitorship / Sullivan & Cromwell Oversight
threats.entities: Binance Global Exchange, US DOJ Compliance Monitors, Global Law Enforcement
threats.incident: Binance's financial investigations unit, working alongside US DOJ, FBI, and international police, intercepted and froze over $3.2 Billion in laundered assets linked to cyber heists and pig-butchering syndicates.
threats.rootCause: Illicit cyber syndicates exploiting peer-to-peer (P2P) merchant liquidity and rapid cross-chain bridge hops to obscure stolen ransomware and scam proceeds.
threats.consequence: Binance onboarded independent monitors under a 3-year US DOJ monitorship, deploying automated real-time on-chain transaction clustering to blacklist tainted wallets within seconds.

threats.title: Poloniex & Exchange Hot Wallets Drained of $125M: Private Keys Compromised via Malicious Worker Nodes
threats.entities: Poloniex Exchange, TRON & Ethereum Hot Wallets
threats.incident: Hackers systematically drained dozens of ERC-20, TRON, and Bitcoin hot-wallets belonging to Poloniex and associated liquidity pools, siphoning $125 Million within 40 minutes.
threats.rootCause: Compromise of internal automated hot-wallet sweep private keys through developer workstation infostealer malware and compromised cloud infrastructure tokens.
threats.consequence: Operator offered 5% white-hat bounty; FBI formally attributed the heist to North Korea's Lazarus Group; affected stablecoin assets frozen on centralized exchanges via Tether and Circle.

threats.title: Euler Finance $197M Flash Loan Exploit: The Landmark Case Where the Attacker Returned 100% of Stolen Crypto
threats.ref: CertiK Case Study / Block 16817996 Flash Loan Attack
threats.entities: Euler Finance Lending Protocol, DAI, WBTC, stETH & USDC Pools
threats.incident: An attacker executed a series of flash loans against Euler's decentralized lending protocol, draining $197 Million in DAI, WBTC, stETH, and USDC within 6 blocks.
threats.rootCause: Flawed liquidation logic in Euler's donateToReserves function: it allowed a borrower to donate collateral to create an artificial insolvency condition without checking overall account health, triggering undercollateralized liquidations.
threats.consequence: Following an on-chain message negotiation and global law enforcement mobilization, the exploiter returned all 100% of the funds; protocol relaunched with modular risk architecture.

threats.title: Ledger Connect Kit Web3 Supply Chain Attack: Compromised NPM Account Injects Wallet Draining Script
threats.entities: Ledger Connect Kit Library, SushiSwap, Zapper, Revoke.cash Frontends
threats.incident: Threat actors published malicious versions (1.1.5 - 1.1.7) of Ledger's official Connect Kit library, injecting crypto-draining code into dozens of top Web3 frontends.
threats.rootCause: Phishing attack targeted a former Ledger employee whose personal NPM access tokens had not been revoked upon departure, allowing direct unauthorized package publishing without 2FA enforcement.
threats.consequence: Ledger purged the rogue versions within 44 minutes and committed to disabling clear-signing on Ledger devices worldwide by replacing it with verifiable Smart Signatures.

threats.title: Change Healthcare Cyber Catastrophe: $22M Ransom Paid to BlackCat as Unpatched Citrix Gateway Halts US Healthcare
threats.sourceName: Krebs on Security & U.S. Congressional Testimony
threats.entities: Change Healthcare, UnitedHealth Group, US Hospitals & Pharmacies
threats.incident: ALPHV/BlackCat ransomware gang locked Change Healthcare's billing and claims processing systems, halting prescription processing and medical claims nationwide for weeks.
threats.rootCause: Single remote-access Citrix server did not have Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) enabled; credentials obtained from an infostealer marketplace were used to log directly into the enterprise core network.
threats.consequence: Parent company UnitedHealth paid a $22M Bitcoin ransom; BlackCat executed an exit scam stealing the payout from their affiliate; total recovery and remediation costs exceeded $3 Billion.

threats.title: Operation Cronos: International Coalition Seizes LockBit Infrastructure, Captures Source Code & Decryption Keys
threats.sourceName: UK National Crime Agency (NCA) & FBI Press Office
threats.ref: Operation Cronos Joint Law Enforcement Bulletin
threats.entities: LockBit Ransomware Syndicate, 34 Global C2 Servers, Dark Web Portals
threats.incident: Law enforcement task force compromised LockBit's core command-and-control servers, seizing 34 servers, arresting affiliates, and taking control of their dark web leak portal to publish police bulletins.
threats.rootCause: Law enforcement exploited an unpatched PHP vulnerability (CVE-2023-3824) on LockBit's internal administrative backend panels, gaining full root access to their decryption key database.
threats.consequence: Authorities released free decryption tools saving hundreds of victims millions; leader Dmitry Khoroshev unmasked and placed on US State Department $10M bounty list.

threats.title: Massive Snowflake Cloud Data Theft: Infostealer Malware Exposes Ticketmaster, Santander & AT&T Records
threats.entities: Snowflake Cloud Tenants, Ticketmaster, Santander, AT&T
threats.incident: UNC5537 threat actors breached over 165 major organizations' Snowflake cloud databases, stealing 560M Ticketmaster customer tickets, 30M Santander records, and AT&T call logs.
threats.rootCause: Targeted accounts lacked Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and used old passwords dating back years that were harvested by Lumma and RedLine infostealer malware on contractor laptops.
threats.consequence: Snowflake rolled out mandatory MFA enforcement across all customer administrator accounts and introduced built-in network security policy templates.

threats.title: CrowdStrike Falcon Sensor Kernel Update Outage: Logic Error in Channel File 291 Causes Global Flight & Banking Meltdown
threats.entities: 8.5M Windows Hosts, Global Airlines, Healthcare & Banking Terminals
threats.incident: A faulty Rapid Response Content update pushed to CrowdStrike Falcon sensors caused an out-of-bounds memory read in csagent.sys, crashing 8.5 million Windows computers into an unbootable Blue Screen of Death loop.
threats.rootCause: Content Validator software bug failed to catch an input mismatch where the sensor expected 21 input fields but the channel file provided only 20, bypassing staging rings and deploying instantly to 100% of global sensors.
threats.consequence: Caused over $5.4 Billion in direct Fortune 500 losses; sparked widespread changes in OS kernel access architectures by Microsoft and security vendors.
